name: Death Rule: Fear Complex
source:
A familiar face, a different world...
It is the night of Halloween, and the festivities are beginning to come to a close. A group of 14 people join up by a campfire, and begin to tell tales of unimaginable horrors...
translation:
熟悉的面孔，不同的世界……
万圣节之夜到了，庆祝活动也开始接近尾声。14人聚集在篝火旁，开始讲述难以想象的恐怖故事……
